customer: hi so northwind offerd me more for my leased pickup then what i owe on the buyout, do i actualy get that extra money?? its thru Bluewater Leasing if that matters, im a college student so every bit helps lol
agent: Thanks for reaching out! When our offer is higher than your lease buyout amount, the difference is called lease equity, and who receives it depends on your leasing company. With Bluewater Leasing, that equity is applied to the car you buy from Northwind rather than paid out to you. You can find more details in our article "If our offer is more than your lease buyout."
